written: 2026-10-02, lane Q3, before any new measurement
purpose: Diagnose three failure modes of the repaired B2 recipe; decide per mode: implementation defect, property of the method, or fragile design choice. No frozen recipe is changed; recommendations go to the owner.

evidence.panel: imagenet_screen_1k (frozen 1k screen; contains dev512 on which B2 was chosen): every number is development evidence
evidence.calibration: B2 v1 calibration observations (unchanged) and the first 256 images of imagenet_calibration_2k (the B2 bias-correction set, existing cache entry, build=False); never the 2000-image entry
evidence.held_out: ImageNet 10k beyond the screen and COCO are not touched
evidence.learned_rounding: L6 fits (artifacts/experiment_b2_recon/fits, read-only); no new AdaRound fit
evidence.readout: expected-credit top-1 primary (credit 1/k when the label is among k tied maxima), lowest-index secondary; one-class share = largest fraction of images on which one class is among the maxima (L6 addendum-1 primary share); collapse = one-class share >= 0.90
evidence.statistics: paired image bootstrap of the expected-credit difference, 10000 resamples, seed 20260927 (tools.analysis.b2_ties.paired); pointwise 95 percent intervals, no multiplicity correction

identity_checks: every reference arm rebuilt by this lane must reproduce the existing record: L6 arms by deployed_state_sha256 and 1000/1000 top-5 lists; matrix cells by configuration identity and readout arrays

the lane's re-implementation of sequential correction in policy 'global' must give the same corrected biases as tools.experiment_b2.engine.bias_correct (max abs difference <= 1e-5 relative to bias scale) and the same top-5 lists

mode1_bias_correction.reference_method: Nagel et al. 2019 (DFQ, arXiv 1906.04721) section 4.2 and Appendix D: per-channel pre-activation means of the FP32 network on N images; for each layer in order, after every producer is corrected, subtract E[y_q]-E[y_fp] from the bias; run with quantized weights only (activations FP32), quantize activations afterwards. AdaRound (arXiv 2004.10568) Table 8: ResNet18 W4 per-layer nearest 23.99, empirical bias correction 38.87; its eq. 26 writes the correction with the same input x for both terms.

hypotheses.H1.0_fidelity: B2 bias_correct implements the Appendix-D procedure (FP32 reference, sign, channel axis, order, bias before the fused nonlinearity, nothing applied twice) with one deviation: it runs with quantized activations. Defect if an independent re-implementation differs or a structural slip is found.
hypotheses.H1.1_mechanism: At large weight error the correction of late layers is dominated by inherited drift E[W(x_fp - x_q)] (upstream noise rectified by ReLU raises input means), not by the layer's own error E[(W - W_q) x_q]; the global correction cancels the drift with large negative shifts that push channels below the ReLU threshold, so late channels go dead and image-to-image spread collapses. Predictions: in collapse cells the inherited part exceeds the local part in the layers where correction RMS > FP32 channel-mean RMS; more always-off channels after correction than in FP32 and in the uncorrected network; fc spread ratio corrected/FP32 < 0.2.
hypotheses.H1.2_sample_size: Not a sample-size effect: the collapse persists at 32, 64, 128 and 256 correction images.
hypotheses.H1.3_variants: Variants that do not chase inherited drift (local_empirical, analytic_fp32, linear_only) avoid collapse in the 5 cells and are not worse than no correction by more than 2 points there; cap_rms reduces but may not remove the collapse; executed (recompute the layer with its corrected bias) equals B2 within 0.3 point; dfq_weights_only equals B2 at A32 by construction.

variants.executed: global, but each corrected layer is recomputed with its new bias in the staged pass (executed arithmetic)
variants.dfq_weights_only: global computed with every activation boundary unquantized (Appendix D literal), deployed with the recipe's activation quantization
variants.cap_rms: global, with the correction vector of each layer scaled down so its RMS does not exceed the RMS of the FP32 channel means
variants.linear_only: global, applied only at conv/linear layers whose output does not feed a rectifier (ReLU/ReLU6) directly, i.e. block outputs, projections, downsample and classifier (per layer-group correction)
variants.local_empirical: own-error correction E[(W - W_q) x_q] with x_q the corrected quantized network's input (AdaRound eq. 26 read with x = x_q)
variants.analytic_fp32: own-error correction (W - W_q) applied to the FP32 network's input E[x_fp] (DFQ section 4.2 analytic form, with the empirical FP32 input instead of batch-norm statistics)
variants.images_32_64_128: b2 on the first 32/64/128 of the 256 correction images

cells.faithfulness: resnet18 W4/A32 one MSE scale per layer, nearest (paper 23.99 / 38.87)
cells.equal_format: INT4, INT5, INT6 weights and activations, nearest, default recipe, all three networks
cells.helps: mobilenet_v3_large INT8 nearest default and learned (L6 fit) default

mode1_bias_correction.instrumentation: per conv/linear layer, policies none and b2 (and the variants on the faithfulness cell and the 5 cells): correction RMS, FP32 channel-mean RMS, local and inherited parts, fraction of always-off channels (positive on < 1 percent of positions) in FP32 / corrected network, across-image spread of per-image channel means (screen images 0..63, diagnostic only)

hypotheses.H2.1_no_slip: scale_for maps the per-channel max-abs weight to the top codebook level (posit8_es1 4096, posit6_es1 256); the table holds the posit values; no slip.
hypotheses.H2.2_mechanism: Under max-abs the largest weights fall into the top regimes, where posit8_es1 has levels 4096, 1024, 512, 256 (weights in 0.19..0.63 of max all map to 0.25 of max), so the layer weight SQNR is far below the MSE-scale SQNR; the bulk sits where spacing is 25 to 50 percent.
hypotheses.H2.3_anchor: Anchoring max-abs at 1.0 (scale = maxabs) recovers posit8 to within 2 points of the MSE weight scale on all three networks; for posit6 (2 fraction bits at 1, none at 1/16) anchor-at-1 stays below MSE.
hypotheses.H2.4_nodes: The MobileNetV2 posit8 one-class output is driven by a small group of late layers; quantizing only that group with max-abs (others MSE) reproduces the one-class output and the reverse arm removes it.

mode2_posit_maxabs.arms: minimal recipe with weight anchors maxpos (= minimal), one, mse (= minimal with MSE weight scales); posit8_es1 and posit6_es1, three networks; MobileNetV2 posit8 layer-group swaps
mode2_posit_maxabs.weight_analysis: CPU: per-layer weight SQNR and level occupancy under each anchor

mode3_wide_exponent.fact_to_verify: for non-integer formats default and minimal differ only in weight range and bias correction (fused_relu, MSE activation ranges, signed codes in both); verified by plan and activation-scale equality

hypotheses.H3.1: The default-minus-minimal loss of fp8_e5m2, fp6_e3m2, log6, mxfp6_e3m2 on ResNet18 and MobileNetV2 is caused by bias correction: default_no_bias_correction recovers at least half of the loss with an interval excluding zero, with the H1.1 mechanism (late always-off channels; features_18 output 99.6 vs 93.5 percent zero codes on MobileNetV2 E5M2).
hypotheses.H3.2_alternative: The MSE weight scale causes it: default_weight_maxabs recovers the loss.

mode3_wide_exponent.arms: default_no_bias_correction and default_weight_maxabs for fp8_e5m2, fp6_e3m2, log6, posit6_es1 (three networks) and mxfp6_e3m2 (ResNet18 and MobileNetV2), plus the mode-1 variants on the scalar formats
mode3_wide_exponent.decision: a switch is the cause if removing it alone recovers >= 50 percent of the default-minus-minimal loss with the paired interval of (arm - default) excluding zero

verdict_rule: defect = the code does not do what the cited method prescribes; property = the faithful method fails in this regime; fragile design = a recipe choice that is defensible but fails for a format family and has a cheap alternative.
budget: about 1.5-2 GPU-hours, at most 2 jobs; disk <= 0.1 GB
